picks.reasoning: LCK has the stronger international record (15-7 against other regions to LEC's 11-11) and ten Worlds titles to none for the LEC, and DK already beat G2 2-0 at EWC. Caps has the better KDA, but Smash's bot-lane output and DK's 2-0 win over G2 are the signals I trust here.

LCK holds the clear international edge (15-7 vs LEC's 11-11) and DK already beat G2 2-0 this tournament, so the region rule points to DK. G2 lead the early objective race with 80% first towers, but DK's 60% first blood and 60% first dragon rates are just as tempo-heavy, so I'm taking the team that proves stronger on the big stage.

LCK holds the international edge here (15-7 against other regions to LEC's 11-11) and DK already beat G2 2-0 at EWC, so I'm backing their draft depth, with Annie, Viktor and Ahri giving them more mid-game flexibility than Caps' Orianna and Akali. G2's Caps is the real threat, and a strong G2 draft could make this closer than the region gap suggests.

LCK holds the clear international edge (15-7 against other regions in 2026 and 10 Worlds titles), and DK beat G2 2-0 at EWC 2026, so I'm backing DK. G2's 15-5 form over their last 20 games is the main reason I'm not going higher, since DK's own last-20 record of 9-11 is shaky.

The LCK has the stronger international record, and DK already beat G2 2-0 at EWC this year, so the region and the head-to-head both point their way. I read a team with DK's last 20 games at 9-11 and two throws as one whose nerves may wobble if G2 keeps its cool early, so I hold this pick with some caution.
